items.text: Eagles Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go MNF vs Bears; Hollywood Brown out.
items.opportunity: Barkley/Smith full snaps vs Bears (Williams out).

items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams for MNF vs Eagles; Bagent questionable after full practice.
items.opportunity: Bears pass catchers vs Eagles D with backup QB.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday injury report; Rapoport notes not expected to play.
items.why: Hip/groin; limited progress per McVay earlier.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams 42% target rate on routes without Nacua historically.

items.text: Nico Collins OUT on ETR list; Schefter/Rapoport confirm hamstring, second straight miss.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes/28% target share last week without Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT; Steelers coach says Jaylen Warren will lead the group.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + spammed checkdowns as vertical game struggles for Rodgers; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT; Mariota starts, positive longer-term not IR.
items.implication: Mariota QB; McLaurin still viable but tough matchup.
items.opportunity: McLaurin 25% target share historically with Mariota.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in despite QUESTIONABLE listings.
items.implication: Start with confidence if no late change.

items.text: Alec Pierce OUT (heel/IR context); Downs target share jumped previously.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs 36% target share after Pierce exit, more perimeter routes.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks OUT; Berry notes expected IR, Hubbard firmly lead.
items.opportunity: Hubbard RB14 utilization through 2 weeks into lead role.

items.text: Projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg).
With Dowdle out, Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect checkdown spam as vertical game failed; Homer/Heidenreich backups. Projecting Warren in despite Q.
items.why: Coach: Warren lead group; LP practice.
items.implication: High volume RB2/flex with receiving upside.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Collins out; Colts 4th-most TE yards allowed. Fact: 30% routes targeted.
Davante Adams 142 routes without Nacua: 60 targets (42%); prior games 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (high prop, DAL 30th rush D). Fact: post-fumble Henderson 65% snaps/16-5 touches over Stevenson rest of game, but still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3.
items.why: Matchup/volume for Henry; narrowed gap but Stevenson lead.
items.opportunity: Henry volume; Henderson rising but not lead yet.
